description: Unsigned transactions to repay a gAIX loan from the wallet (part, or all: true to clear it exactly) and, if asked, take gAIX back to the wallet (take_back: shares, or "all"). Repaying always works, weekends included; taking gAIX back while a loan stays open pauses every weekend and whenever a basket price is out of date, and keeps the loan under three quarters of its limit. Simulated from the wallet.

amount.description: USDG to repay, as a decimal string, like "100"

take_back.description: gAIX to take back, in shares as a decimal string, or "all"

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign

name: gaix_repay
title: Prepare: repay a gAIX loan and take gAIX back
